sub_graphs.title: Prague: KECCAK256 Instruction Execution Flow
sub_graphs.description: Models the complete execution lifecycle of the KECCAK256 opcode from stack inputs through hash computation to result output

nodes.label: KECCAK256 Opcode Dispatched
nodes.description: EVM has fetched and dispatched the KECCAK256 (0x20) opcode for execution

nodes.label: Pop Memory Start Index
nodes.description: Pop the first stack element to get memory_start_index where data begins

nodes.label: Pop Size Parameter
nodes.description: Pop the second stack element to get the size (number of bytes to hash)

nodes.label: Stack Parameters Retrieved
nodes.description: Both memory_start_index and size have been successfully popped from stack

nodes.label: Calculate Word Count
nodes.description: Calculate the number of 32-byte words needed to cover the data for gas calculation

nodes.label: Compute Memory Expansion Gas
nodes.description: Calculate gas cost for expanding memory using calculate_gas_extend_memory()

nodes.label: Charge Total Gas
nodes.description: Charge total gas: GAS_KECCAK256 + (GAS_KECCAK256_WORD * words) + memory expansion cost

nodes.label: Gas Successfully Charged
nodes.description: All gas costs have been charged, execution can proceed

nodes.label: Expand Memory if Needed
nodes.description: Expand memory with null bytes if the requested range exceeds current memory size

nodes.label: Read Memory Bytes
nodes.description: Read data from memory using memory_read_bytes() at start index for specified size

nodes.label: Data Loaded in Buffer
nodes.description: The bytes to be hashed have been read from memory into a buffer

nodes.label: Compute Keccak-256 Hash
nodes.description: Execute the Keccak-256 hash algorithm on the extracted data

nodes.label: Hash Computed
nodes.description: The 32-byte Keccak-256 hash has been computed

nodes.label: Push Hash to Stack
nodes.description: Push the resulting hash as a U256 value onto the stack

nodes.label: Increment Program Counter
nodes.description: Increment the program counter by 1 to advance to the next instruction

nodes.label: KECCAK256 Execution Complete
nodes.description: The KECCAK256 instruction has completed successfully

sub_graphs.title: Prague: KECCAK256 Gas Metering
sub_graphs.description: Models the gas calculation and charging mechanism for the KECCAK256 opcode

nodes.label: Gas Calculation Initiated
nodes.description: Gas calculation begins with size parameter available

nodes.label: GAS_KECCAK256 Base Cost
nodes.description: Base gas cost constant for KECCAK256 operation (30 gas)

nodes.label: GAS_KECCAK256_WORD Cost
nodes.description: Gas cost per 32-byte word hashed (6 gas per word)

nodes.label: Compute Word Count
nodes.description: Calculate number of 32-byte words: ceil(size / 32)

nodes.label: Compute Word-Based Gas
nodes.description: Multiply word count by GAS_KECCAK256_WORD

nodes.label: Invoke Memory Gas Calculator
nodes.description: Call calculate_gas_extend_memory() with memory bounds

nodes.label: Memory Expansion Cost Known
nodes.description: Memory expansion gas cost has been calculated

nodes.label: Sum Total Gas Cost
nodes.description: Add base cost + word cost + memory expansion cost

nodes.label: Total Gas Cost Computed
nodes.description: Final gas cost for the operation is determined

nodes.label: Deduct Gas from Available
nodes.description: Subtract computed gas from evm.gas_left

nodes.label: Gas Sufficient
nodes.description: Sufficient gas available, execution proceeds

nodes.label: Out of Gas Error
nodes.description: Insufficient gas, execution reverts with OutOfGasError

sub_graphs.title: Prague: KECCAK256 Memory State Transitions
sub_graphs.description: Models memory access and expansion during KECCAK256 execution

nodes.label: Initial Memory State
nodes.description: Memory in its current state before KECCAK256 operation

nodes.label: Compare Access Bounds
nodes.description: Compare memory_start_index + size against current memory size

nodes.label: Memory Expansion Required
nodes.description: Requested memory range exceeds current allocation

nodes.label: No Expansion Needed
nodes.description: Requested memory range is within current allocation

nodes.label: Calculate New Memory Size
nodes.description: Determine new memory size rounded to 32-byte words

nodes.label: Extend Memory with Zeros
nodes.description: Pad memory with null bytes to reach new required size

nodes.label: Memory Expanded
nodes.description: Memory has been expanded with zero-padding

nodes.label: Read Bytes from Memory
nodes.description: Extract bytes from memory[start:start+size]

nodes.label: Bytes Extracted
nodes.description: Data bytes have been extracted for hashing

ambiguities.text: The specification does not explicitly define error handling when stack underflow occurs during pop operations
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume standard EVM stack underflow behavior applies - execution reverts with StackUnderflowError if fewer than 2 elements on stack.

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'number of 32-byte chunks needed to cover the data' does not specify rounding behavior for non-multiple sizes
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume ceiling division is used: words = ceil(size / 32). This matches standard EVM word calculation patterns.

implicit_assumptions.description: The Keccak-256 implementation is assumed to be cryptographically secure and correctly implemented
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Hash collisions or preimage attacks could compromise contract security, storage slot calculations, and event topic matching.

implicit_assumptions.description: Memory expansion gas calculation is assumed to prevent memory exhaustion attacks
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attackers could cause nodes to run out of memory by requesting large memory expansions without sufficient gas cost.

implicit_assumptions.description: The memory read operation is assumed to only read from the EVM's internal memory space
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Out-of-bounds memory access could lead to information leakage or memory corruption.
